name: NyxBot Voice
description: Realtime voice for one owner-published personal Bot. Grant a board Agent Key access to that exact Voice UserService. The connection selects the Bot; the board credential identifies the caller. A generic catalog connection authorizes no Bot. Each Bot keeps its own existing service grants and billing.
auth_notes: Set base_url to this NyxID deployment. Owner publication creates a real service endpoint at {BASE_URL}/api/v1/proxy/nyxbot-voice/{service_id}. Call that endpoint directly with the board Agent Key and proxy scope. The service checks the exact UserService grant and bound Bot before using the existing Voice runtime. No downstream credential is distributed or caller Bearer forwarded.
known_limitations: Personal owned Bots only. Publish through Agent details; direct catalog connection does not bind a Bot. This is an HTTP/WebSocket service, not an MCP tool offering: keep openapi_spec_url empty and do not import the reference OpenAPI document as catalog ServiceEndpoint rows. Operation-scoped Keys cannot open WebSockets under existing policy. Explicit service Deny rules remain effective; Voice does not create service-operation approval requests. Owner action cards are confirmed in NyxID. Devices share the Bot home thread and existing per-person live-call slot. Upgrade and drain all API and background workers before enabling assistant:voice-agent-key. Announcement support is exposed per provider option.
